title: aspidium marginale
intro: Aspidium marginale, commonly known as the Margined Lady Fern or the Margined Osmunda, is a species of fern native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium marginale include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Aspidium marginale are also known to exhibit immunomodulatory and neuroprotective effects, making it a potential candidate for the development of new therapeutic agents.
